articles.summary: CONTAGEM, Brazil, Oct 29, 2026 – Wabtec (NYSE: WAB) celebrated a historic milestone with the production of the1,000th locomotive at its Contagem plant in the metropolitan area of Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais. The achievement symbolizes more than five decades of transformation when the Brazilian operation evolved from a component repair center into one of the company’s leading railway manufacturing and technology development hubs.
articles.title: Wabtec’s Contagem Plant Celebrates its 1,000th Locomotive

articles.summary: PITTSBURGH, October 21, 2026 – Wabtec Corporation (NYSE: WAB) today reported third quarter 2026 GAAP earnings per diluted share of $2.42, up 33.7% versus the third quarter of 2025. Adjusted earnings per diluted share were $2.83, up 22.0% versus the same quarter a year ago. Third quarter sales were $3.12 billion and cash from operations was $455 million.
articles.title: Wabtec Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Results

articles.summary: PITTSBURGH, Oct. 14, 2026 – Wabtec Corporation (NYSE: WAB) announced today that its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly common dividend of 31 cents per share, payable on December 1, 2026, to holders of record on November 17, 2026.
articles.title: https://www.wabteccorp.com/newsroom/press-releases/wabtec-declares-regular-quarterly-common-dividend-18

articles.summary: PITTSBURGH, October 1, 2026 – Wabtec Corporation (NYSE: WAB) announced it will report 2026 third quarter results before the U.S. financial markets open on October 21, 2026. The company will conduct a conference call to discuss those results with analysts and investors at 8:30 a.m. ET the same day.
articles.title: Wabtec Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date
